newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Novartis in venture for bone therapies.
newsitem.headline: Novartis in venture for bone therapies.

text.p: Novartis AG said it plans to collaborate with Osiris Therapeutics Inc of the U.S. to develop therapeutic products for tissue regeneration based on human Mesenchymal Stem Cells (MSC).
Terms of the collaboration include an equity investment of $10 million in Osiris, and an upfront payment of $3 million for research.
Mesenchymal stem cells are progenitor cells which can differentiate into multiple connective tissues including bone, cartilage, muscle, tendon, bone marrow stroma and fat.

Osiris Therapeutics, based in Baltimore, Maryland, conducts research and development of novel therapeutic products for the regeneration of diseased or injured tissue based on human MSC stem cells, which the company believes are the progenitors responsible for the formation of connective tissues, Novartis also said. -- Zurich Editorial +41 1 631 7340
